name: mi.team
description_en:
mi.team currently presents an employee activity insight and Windows device monitoring platform. It connects application and website activity with individual, team and company views, alongside device health information. The existing directory’s chat, calendar and collaborative-document labels do not describe the current official product evidence.

Its central selection question is what activity reaches a manager, how private activity is hidden and which plan gives employees their own controls. The vendor describes Privacy AI and contextual productivity analysis, but their accuracy, enforcement and suitability for a particular workplace were not independently tested.
description_zh:
mi.team 当前官网介绍的是员工活动洞察及 Windows 设备监控平台，把应用、网站活动与个人、团队、公司视图关联，并提供设备健康信息。既有目录中的聊天、日历及协作文档标签缺乏当前官方产品证据。

选型的核心问题是哪些活动会展示给管理者、私有活动如何隐藏，以及哪个套餐让员工拥有自己的控制入口。厂商介绍了 Privacy AI 和结合上下文的生产力分析，但其准确性、权限执行及特定工作场所适用性未经独立测试。

core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商描述自动隐藏及员工私有标记；实际套餐资格与行为需确认。

en: Evaluate one approved Windows test device, its account association, activity visibility and a manager/employee privacy demonstration.

steps.zh: 通过虚构活动试点确认套餐隐私控制、终端支持及登记归属。

steps.zh: 扩大采用前检查可见性、分类错误、移除／导出及合同数据处理。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: What the dashboard observes, and what it cannot prove
sections.title_zh: 仪表盘观察什么，又不能证明什么
sections.en:
The feature page describes live application use, daily app/website summaries, work timelines and organization-wide patterns. AI productivity views use role and company context, while expert discovery and alerts extend the interpretation of this activity. These are vendor-described signals rather than measured employee outcomes.

For a proposed support team evaluation, compare one ordinary workday with the actual tasks completed. Time in a browser may represent research, a customer session or waiting; the public pages do not disclose a validated scoring formula or error rate. A manager should investigate the context of an alert rather than treat an activity classification as proof of contribution or poor performance. No workforce records were collected or evaluated.
sections.zh:
功能页描述实时应用使用、每日应用／网站摘要、工作时间线和组织模式。AI 生产力视图结合角色及公司上下文，专家发现及提醒会进一步解释这些活动。这些是厂商描述的信号，不是测得的员工成果。

假设评估支持团队，可把普通工作日的活动与实际完成任务对应。浏览器时间可能代表研究、客户会话或等待；公开页面未披露经验证的评分公式或误差率。管理者应调查提醒的上下文，而非把活动分类当作贡献或表现不佳的证明。本研究未收集或评估员工记录。

sections.title_en: Verify employee controls before enrolling devices
sections.title_zh: 登记设备前先核对员工控制入口
sections.en:
Privacy AI is described as hiding sensitive activity such as banking, health browsing and personal communication from management views and reports. Employees can also mark activity private. The same marketing says privacy is enabled by default, yet the pricing matrix excludes AI Privacy Shield and the employee portal from Free and includes them on paid plans. The public evidence does not resolve how Free protects sensitive activity or whether the differently named privacy features are equivalent.

Request a demonstration with synthetic activity across employee and manager roles: inspect initial visibility, later redaction and report access. This proposed test is needed before trusting the claim; the documentation does not establish classifier accuracy, administrator override rules or whether a manual mark removes already exported information.
sections.zh:
Privacy AI 被描述为从管理视图和报告中隐藏银行、健康浏览及私人通信等敏感活动，员工也可自行标为私有。营销同时称隐私默认启用，但定价表把 AI Privacy Shield 和员工门户排除在 Free 外，付费套餐才提供。公开证据未解决 Free 如何保护敏感活动，也未证明不同名称的隐私功能等价。

可要求用虚构活动演示员工和管理者角色，检查首次可见范围、事后遮盖和报告访问。信任主张前需要该拟议测试；文档未确立分类准确率、管理员覆盖规则，或手动标记能否移除已经导出的信息。

sections.title_en: Enrollment binds a Windows agent to the account
sections.title_zh: 登记把 Windows Agent 绑定到账户
sections.en:
The deployment guide uses an organization enrolment code from Deploy. A preconfigured Windows installer embeds it; scripted deployment passes it to the installer. Documented distribution options include Group Policy, Intune and RMM tooling, with successful installation provisioning the device against that account. This requires endpoint deployment capability, not simply inviting someone to a browser workspace.

For a proposed pilot, use an approved test device and confirm the resulting organization and device association before wider rollout. The Intune example leaves detection and uninstall details to the operator; those gaps matter for repeatable deployment and removal. Public installation instructions alone do not establish supported Windows versions, update rollback, an uninstall procedure or macOS/Linux agent parity. No installer or command was executed.
sections.zh:
部署指南使用 Deploy 中的组织登记码。预配置 Windows 安装程序内含该码，脚本部署则把码传给安装程序。文档分发方式包括 Group Policy、Intune 及 RMM，成功安装后会把设备登记到账户。这需要终端部署能力，不能只邀请用户进入网页工作区。

假设做试点，应使用获准的测试设备，在扩大部署前确认所属组织及设备关联。Intune 示例把检测和卸载细节留给操作者，这些缺口影响可重复部署及移除。公开安装步骤本身未确立支持的 Windows 版本、更新回滚、卸载流程或 macOS／Linux Agent 一致性。本研究未运行安装程序或命令。

sections.title_en: A device warning is a diagnosis starting point
sections.en:
The asset page explicitly describes Windows desktops, workstations and servers. It reports CPU, memory, uptime, storage and update information; the broader feature list also names firewall and BitLocker status. These views can help distinguish an overloaded or unhealthy device from an activity pattern, but a displayed warning does not demonstrate that a patch was installed, encryption changed or an incident resolved.

Before adopting it as a fleet tool, check reporting freshness, offline-device handling and the actual corrective workflow on the intended endpoints. Remote control, patch execution, recovery automation and a complete asset export were not verified. Device monitoring and activity interpretation should each be evaluated against their own operational task.
sections.zh:
资产页明确描述 Windows 桌面、工作站及服务器，报告 CPU、内存、运行时长、存储及更新信息；较广功能页还列出防火墙和 BitLocker 状态。这些视图可帮助区分设备过载／异常与活动模式，但显示警告不证明补丁已安装、加密已改变或事件已解决。

作为设备群工具采用前，应在目标终端检查报告新鲜度、离线设备处理及实际纠正流程。远程控制、补丁执行、自动恢复及完整资产导出尚未核实。设备监控与活动解释应分别按各自运行任务评估。

sections.title_en: Use current displayed fees without resolving conflicts by guesswork
sections.title_zh: 采用当前显示费用，保留未解决冲突
sections.en:
The director plan page displays Standard at £5/user/month, up to 500 members, and Pro at £10 with unlimited members. Standard adds detailed timelines and one-year history; Pro adds expert/skills views, nudges, integrations on request and five-year history. These are plan features, not guarantees of complete retention, recovery or a working Slack/SSO connector.

The browser calculator shows Standard for 10 users on Yearly at £45/month billed annually, equivalent to £540/year before any unverified tax or extras. Free cards say 10 members while the expanded comparison says 50. A separate six-month offer is limited to the first 50 teams and is not evidence that a particular applicant qualifies. Confirm Free capacity, billable user/device definition, tax, commitment, renewal and cancellation before purchasing. No checkout was performed.
sections.zh:
面向企业管理者的套餐页显示 Standard 每用户每月 £5，最多500成员；Pro £10，成员不限。Standard 增加详细时间线及一年历史，Pro 增加专家／技能视图、提醒、按需集成及五年历史。这些是套餐功能，不保证完整保留、恢复或 Slack／SSO 连接器已可运行。

浏览器计算器在 Standard、10用户、Yearly 时显示按年结算每月 £45，等值每年 £540，未计尚未核实的税及额外项。Free 卡写10成员，展开对比表写50。另有仅限首50团队的六个月优惠，不证明某个申请者合资格。购买前应确认免费容量、计费用户／设备定义、税、承诺期、续订及取消。本研究未结账。

sections.title_en: Data handling remains a contract and implementation question
sections.title_zh: 数据处理仍需合同及实现核实
sections.en:
The actual privacy notice names Network Limited as operator and describes computer-usage logs, necessary-duration retention, deletion or anonymization, and safeguarded international transfers. It also describes information and human-review safeguards for solely automated decisions with significant effects. These are the operator’s stated practices, not an independent compliance finding or a product-specific deletion timetable.

An IT or operations team considering this product needs endpoint access and a clear plan for how staff see and challenge activity interpretation. The public material did not establish a software license, self-hosting package, tenant backup/restore, raw-activity export, precise purge time or exit charges. Keep those unresolved before sensitive rollout. No old chat/calendar capabilities, legal conclusion or permanent-free entitlement was inferred from branding or promotion.
sections.zh:
实际隐私通知将 Network Limited 列为运营者，描述计算机使用日志、按必要时长保留、删除或匿名化及有保障的国际传输，也描述对具有重大影响的纯自动决策提供信息和人工复核保障。这些是运营者的声明，不是独立合规结论，也不是产品专属删除时间表。

考虑该产品的 IT 或运营团队，需要终端访问能力，并明确员工如何查看及质疑活动解释。公开材料未确立软件许可证、自托管包、租户备份／恢复、原始活动导出、精确清除时间或退出费用。敏感部署前应保留这些未决项。没有根据品牌或优惠推断旧聊天／日历能力、法律结论或永久免费资格。
